test_non_empty_xml_output: test that gtest produces correct non-empty XML output with failures, disabled tests, and properties
test_empty_xml_output: test that gtest produces valid empty XML output when no tests are present
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in gtest XML output is a valid ISO datetime string
test_default_output_file: test that gtest writes XML output to the default file test_detail.xml when no path is specified
test_filtered_test_xml_output: test that gtest XML output includes only tests matching the gtest_filter flag
